tool_args.rationale: The authorized mechanism note identifies a four-parameter coupled memory ODE and requires at least eight rows. Five paid rows leave genuine parameter identifiability ambiguity; the fine trajectory batch is the direct, non-nuisance path to enough data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It may discriminate mechanism class, but the authorized full coupled-memory ODE is explicitly underidentified with only five rows and requires at least eight.
All current rows already use the target horizon H=0.6; the evidence points to a coupled transient lag, so an additional horizon is less useful than enough trajectories to fit its four parameters.
It is explicitly nuisance information and cannot resolve the target-law parameter ambiguity.
Promising given both pilot signatures, but five observations are insufficient to fit its four parameters reliably and meet fresh-confirmation tolerance.
